originality.rationale: Compared published uniform-window primary text and closest semantic research records by implication, not by wording. Known fixed-length difference transformations were explicitly credited and are not claimed as new. The simultaneous two-length bivariate enumerator, conditional nonlinear dependence and alphabet-dependent sharp extremal classification were not identified in the inspected statements; unindexed equivalences remain a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact bivariate enumeration may exist under path-square graph coloring or Potts-model terminology.
The 2018 fixed-window derivative provides key ingredients; the independent new aspect is their joint analysis, not the single-window identity.
Not all related bounded-window papers or appendices were inspected in full; a surviving equivalent published derivation would negate originality.
The previously known bounded-two channel theory is substantial; an unstated consequence in specialized literature could still imply some portion of the proposed spectrum.
